packages.name: Generate WAV from Text
packages.summary: Turns a selected text file into spoken WAV saved beside it.

packages.name: Transcribe Audio
packages.summary: Transcribes selected audio with Voicebox Whisper to a sidecar .txt.

packages.name: Import Voice ZIP
packages.summary: Imports an exported Voicebox profile zip into the local app.

packages.name: Export Voice
packages.summary: Exports a chosen voice profile zip to Downloads.

packages.name: Load Voicebox Model
packages.summary: Loads or unloads a downloaded Voicebox TTS model from a menu.

packages.name: Stream Speak
packages.summary: Streams selected text as WAV from Voicebox with chunked synthesis and gapless local playback.
